name: Bhagavad Gita 3.13
group: The Gita on duty and offering
text:
यज्ञशिष्टाशिनः सन्तो मुच्यन्ते सर्वकिल्बिषैः ।
भुञ्जते ते त्वघं पापा ये पचन्त्यात्मकारणात् ॥
meaning: Those who eat what remains of an offering are freed from all wrongs; those who cook only for themselves eat wrongdoing itself.
purpose: Reflection on gratitude, offering and mindful receiving.
